SQL:
WITH _base AS (
  SELECT
    orders.status AS "customers.orders.status"
  FROM customers AS customers
  LEFT JOIN orders AS orders
    ON customers.id = orders.customer_id
  GROUP BY
    orders.status
), _cm_customers__credit_sum AS (
  SELECT
    _base."customers.orders.status" AS "customers.orders.status",
    CAST(SUM(_base._v) AS DOUBLE) AS "customers.credit_sum_host"
  FROM (
    SELECT
      orders.status AS "customers.orders.status",
      customers.id AS _ek0,
      MAX(customers.credit) AS _v
    FROM customers AS customers
    LEFT JOIN orders AS orders
      ON customers.id = orders.customer_id
    WHERE
      NOT customers.id IS NULL
    GROUP BY
      orders.status,
      customers.id
  ) AS _base
  GROUP BY
    _base."customers.orders.status"
), _cm_customers___count AS (
  SELECT
    _base."customers.orders.status" AS "customers.orders.status",
    COUNT(*) AS "customers._count_host"
  FROM (
    SELECT
      orders.status AS "customers.orders.status",
      customers.id AS _ek0
    FROM customers AS customers
    LEFT JOIN orders AS orders
      ON customers.id = orders.customer_id
    WHERE
      NOT customers.id IS NULL
    GROUP BY
      orders.status,
      customers.id
  ) AS _base
  GROUP BY
    _base."customers.orders.status"
)
SELECT
  _base."customers.orders.status",
  _cm_customers__credit_sum."customers.credit_sum_host" AS "customers.credit_sum",
  COALESCE(_cm_customers___count."customers._count_host", 0) AS "customers._count"
FROM _base
LEFT JOIN _cm_customers__credit_sum
  ON _base."customers.orders.status" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_customers__credit_sum."customers.orders.status"
LEFT JOIN _cm_customers___count
  ON _base."customers.orders.status" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_customers___count."customers.orders.status"
LIMIT 21
